CDL.Reals.MultiSum
  Sum of Reals, y = k[1]*u[1] + k[2]*u[2] + ... + k[n]*u[n]

parameters:
  nin : Integer = 0
      Number of input signals
      range: nin >= 0; nin <= 1048576
  k_<i> : Real = 1.0
      Input gains

inputs:
  u1 : Real
      Input to multiplied by gain and then added
  u2 : Real
      Input to multiplied by gain and then added
  u3 : Real
      Input to multiplied by gain and then added

outputs:
  y : Real
      Sum of inputs times gains

notes:
  (none)

  help in the latest Buildings release (may drift from the pin): https://simulationresearch.lbl.gov/modelica/releases/latest/help/Buildings_Controls_OBC_CDL_Reals.html#Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL.Reals.MultiSum
